title: Generative AI use-cases and design patterns with Databases
description: This in-depth technical session delves into real-world use cases, and design patterns for building generative AI applications using Google Cloud Databases, Vertex AI, and popular open-source orchestration frameworks such as LangChain. We ll showcase a sample application that leverages the versatility of Google Cloud Databases to implement dynamic grounding using various RAG techniques, giving you valuable insights on implementing enterprise-grade gen AI solutions.
